definitions.explanation: Describes a state where things or people follow proper order and rules. Used for situations, behavior, or environments that are neat, systematic, and well-regulated.

examples.japanese: {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧。
⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The evacuation was carried out in an orderly manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sight of Japanese people behaving in an orderly fashion even during disasters attracted worldwide attention.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{秩序|ちつじょ}→秩序：10591_chitsujo⟧ (order, discipline) and ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧ (correct, proper). Describes behavior, situations, or environments that maintain good order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: orderly behavior
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しい⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧: an orderly line/queue
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in an orderly fashion
- {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act in an orderly manner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整然|せいぜん}とした→整然とする：23003_seizentosuru⟧: neat and orderly — focuses on physical arrangement and tidiness
- {規律正|きりつただ}しい: disciplined — emphasizes adherence to rules and regulations
- ⟦{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい→礼儀正しい：15088_reigitadashii⟧: polite / well-mannered — specifically about social etiquette

USAGE:
The adverbial form {秩序正|ちつじょただ}しく is used frequently, as this word often modifies verbs describing collective behavior.
